subject.title: [Feature]: Owner Takeover / Human Handoff for DM Auto-Reply

question: Should OpenClaw add first-class owner/human handoff for personal-number DM auto-reply, and should the initial scope be WhatsApp-only or shared across DM-capable channels?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but solving it adds new config, per-thread state, resume semantics, and channel ownership rules that should be chosen by maintainers before automation writes code.

options.title: Approve WhatsApp-first opt-in
options.body: Add a WhatsApp-owned `humanTakeover`/owner-handoff design with per-DM pause state, cooldown/explicit resume semantics, docs, and live WhatsApp proof before expanding to other channels.

options.title: Design a shared channel SDK seam
options.body: Pause this issue until maintainers define a cross-channel owner-handoff contract for WhatsApp, Telegram, Discord, and future plugins.

options.title: Defer to existing controls
options.body: Close or defer the request and tell users to use `dmPolicy`, allowlists, manual config changes, or instructions rather than adding a new runtime handoff surface.

recommendation.title: Approve WhatsApp-first opt-in
recommendation.body: Add a WhatsApp-owned `humanTakeover`/owner-handoff design with per-DM pause state, cooldown/explicit resume semantics, docs, and live WhatsApp proof before expanding to other channels.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history ties steipete to channel ingress/config policy and the config-surface bar that this product decision needs to satisfy.
